## Preprints & Recent Work
* Key preprints and peer-reviewed articles span from 2006 to 2026, covering topics such as salt marsh microbial ecology, gut microbiomes, and vector genetics. The complete list of publications, including works in *mBio*, *The ISME Journal*, *Limnology and Oceanography*, and his 2022 Northeastern University doctoral dissertation, can be found directly via his [Google Scholar profile](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=2TwdtrcAAAAJ&hl=en) and [ORCID record](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4101-1449).
